# 90 Days of X {.unnumbered}

A **multi-volume learning series**: independent, expert-ordered paths you can take **one at a time** (or in any order you choose). Each volume is a self-contained ~90-day-shaped curriculum. More volumes can be added later without redesigning the others.

**Current volumes**

| Volume | Focus | Start here | Baseline / notes |
|--------|--------|------------|------------------|
| **1 — Go** | Language → concurrency → services → production (+ TinyGo elective) | [Overview](content/01-go/00-sub-book-overview.qmd) · [Syllabus](content/01-go/01-syllabus.qmd) | Go **1.26.x** |
| **2 — Nix & NixOS** | Lab 0 → foundations → flake host → fleet | [Overview](content/02-nixos/00-sub-book-overview.qmd) · [Syllabus](content/02-nixos/01-syllabus.qmd) | Nix **2.34.x** · NixOS **26.05** |
| **3 — Maths** | Scratch → algebra → logic → **discrete math** for CS | [Overview](content/03-maths/00-sub-book-overview.qmd) · [Syllabus](content/03-maths/01-syllabus.qmd) | Pen/paper first |

This is a **study series notebook**, not a certification product and not a prescribed daily timetable. How you schedule hours is yours. **This book holds the volume spines only** — no links out to other monorepo books.

::: {.callout-note}
Start with **[How this series works](content/00-program/00-how-this-series-works.qmd)**.  
Each volume’s contract is its **Syllabus**. Pick **one volume** at a time unless you deliberately juggle.
:::

## Design goals

- **Volumes are separate.** No volume requires another.  
- **Expert order inside each volume.** Gates beat calendars.  
- **No interlinks to other monorepo books** from this series (and no required bridges between volumes).  
- **Syllabus before chapters.**  
- **Series can grow** (`content/04-…`).  

## What “done” looks like

**Per volume:** that volume’s exit criteria and capstone.
